text_replacements.text: Carriers in the Compact vote on a shared rate. Nell Fenwick voted against me twice and for me once. Others want to set their own rates. Leaving an agreement mustn't cost them the right to use the road.
There is still a road open if you want it. Or tell me what you've learned. No need to promise a journey just to ask a question.

You have a rail-payment lead. Tell me how you learned it. If you travelled the line, separate what you saw from what somebody told you.
If you haven't taken the rail, ask about Iron Junction. If you have, tell me what you saw. Don't name a payer unless you've learned who paid.
You have a hire-payment lead for Greenwater. Tell me its source. Going there isn't the only way to hear a claim, and hearing one doesn't prove it.
If you haven't been to Greenwater, ask me the way. If you have, tell me what became of the grain and how you learned it.
You have a payment lead about Red Hollow. Say how you learned it. If you've been to the Mouth, tell me that account separately.
If Red Hollow is still ahead of you, ask me the way. If you've been, tell me what happened at the Mouth. Leave the payment column blank unless you've learned it.
WE'RE THROUGH! Look at what's gone over the side. Granny's going to count every sack we brought home. We'll count the loss before we start calling it a victory.
Greenwater receives the recovered cargo; losses depend on the actual route and pilot state. Hatcher may seek revenge if alive. No fixed fraction or dead pilot is asserted.
The town hanged him after you let them take him. That was your choice. Keeping the law from becoming a rope was my responsibility. Tomorrow we answer for both.
Captain Blevins is making ready to fire. When his preparations are finished, he turns the key with eleven people below. Start the rescue or stop him before then.
Gantt had a name he meant to check against the entries, not an accusation already proved.
You chose to stay with the courier. What she can tell you depends on whether she is still alive to speak.
You choose to stay with the living courier. Only words actually delivered grant spoken knowledge; choosing this course is not proof that they were heard.
Any last words you actually heard are a lead. The number can also be learned from the case; no exclusive knowledge is granted merely by choosing to stay.
You have useful observations of the route. Flint can compare evidence if alive and available. Who can manage the crowd depends on the surviving cast; no dead Brigg is assigned that job.

new_lines.speaker: talbot
new_lines.text: The courier's down. I can keep people back, not do three jobs at once. Somebody stay with her, somebody find the shot, somebody keep that case safe. Choose.

new_lines.speaker: talbot
new_lines.text: The courier is dead. I can keep people back. You can search the roof and landing, or get the case out of the crush.

new_lines.speaker: flint
new_lines.text: The shot came from the roof. Her case is still on her wrist. Help her, take it out of the crush, or come look at the landing. I'm not spending another minute guessing.

new_lines.speaker: flint
new_lines.text: The courier is dead. The shot came from the roof. Search the landing, or take her case out of the crush. Standing here won't tell us who fired.
